plan.title: Saved eRFX Draft Hides Add Attachments

steps.note: Open the eRFX project creation screen.
Enable eRFX project creation for the test tenant.
Set the condition under which Add Attachments must not be offered.
Apply the additional configuration required by the case.
Give the draft a searchable title.
Configure the draft with a pricing template.
Add the required line item for a valid draft.
Complete the pricing sheet so the draft can be saved.
Save the eRFX project as an unpublished draft.
Navigate to the events list to reopen the saved draft.
Confirm the events list rendered before filtering for drafts.
Open the Drafts tab specified by the case.
Verify that the newly saved draft is listed.
Open the saved eRFX draft from the Drafts list.
Assert that Add Attachments is not offered on the reopened draft.
